summary: Amtech Systems filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of 2,926,829 shares of common stock at $20.50 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately $60 million. The offering is a shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration. Titan Partners Group LLC acts as sole underwriter. The shares are Nasdaq-listed; closing is expected June 3, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
